mŏrētārĭus , a, um, adj. moretum,
I.of or belonging to the dish moretum (postclass.): “moretaria condimenta,” Apic. 6, 4 . —Subst.: mŏrētārĭum , ii, n., the dish moretum (made of garlic, rue, vinegar, oil, etc.), Don. ad Ter. Phorm. 2, 2, 4.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
